newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia extends gains after Wall St rally.
newsitem.headline: Nokia extends gains after Wall St rally.

text.p: Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy hit a new 12-month high in lively Friday morning trade after sharp gains on Wall Street following an in-line interim report released on Thursday, broker said.
At 1120/0920 GMT, Nokia's more liquid A share traded at 264.00 markka, up 14.50 markka or 5.8 percent, after hitting 267.50 markka -- its highest since October 19, 1995.
Trade was a lively 136 million markka.
Nokia's A share ADR closed $7-1/2 up at $58-1/2 (about 265.36 markka) in New York on Thursday after hitting $59-1/8. -- Helsinki newsroom +358-9-6805 0248
